name: Swire Coca-Cola USA - Denver Production Plant, CO

fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied '14025 E 38th Ave' and coords 39.770555,-104.819041 - that address is NOT a Swire facility and the coordinates landed in a far-east Denver industrial park (unrelated buildings). The confirmed Swire Coca-Cola Denver production plant is at 3825 N York St / 2145 E 40th Ave, Denver, CO 80205. Positively identified: the building's east facade carries a large Coca-Cola logo with the red dynamic-ribbon wave (confirmed in Street View). Locked center ~39.7701,-104.9618.
fieldNotes.facilityNote: This is the oldest operating Coca-Cola bottling plant in the United States (~90 years old). Swire is building a $475M replacement plant in Colorado Springs (opens spring 2028); the Denver plant is still operating as of May 2026.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The trailer yard is enclosed by chain-link fencing with chain-link sliding gates (visible in Street View, with bollards). Two gate openings observed on the SW side off the yard road. Controlled truck access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the chain-link truck gates in Street View or satellite - basic sliding gates only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present but no guard shack - check-in is kiosk/remote style.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple chain-link gate openings in the yard fence serve as distinct in/out points.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The large fenced trailer yard inside the gate functions as a post-gate holding/queue area before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The fenced trailer yard is large and deep, easily holding a queue of 3+ trucks between the gate and the dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large multi-building production+distribution plant - long dock banks span the north and west faces of the warehouse buildings with dozens of trailers backed in. Banded 50+; exact count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Fenced trailer drop yard with red Coca-Cola trailers/tractors and blue/white trailers - banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3+ connected buildings: the main production plant (Coca-Cola logo facade), a long sawtooth-roof warehouse, and additional warehouse buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple dock faces across the complex but a single integrated operation - could not confirm physically separate ship vs receive clusters; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least 2 gate openings observed in the yard fence; estimate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~355m N-S x ~430m E-W complex) ~ 16 acres - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line / intermodal yard runs immediately north of the property, but no spur appears to run into the plant itself - left false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - dense Denver (Cole/Clayton neighborhood) industrial fabric surrounded by residential.
